title: Bounded symmetric scalar Gaussian channels have an exact eighth-order relative-Fisher expansion

hermite_law.scope: X is one bounded symmetric centered unit-variance real seed.
hermite_law.moments: kappa_4=E H_4(X), kappa_6=E H_6(X), h_8=E H_8(X).

scope_guard: The expansion is a fixed bounded symmetric seed theorem near t=0; it is not a uniform theorem for growing support and does not order exact finite-strength channels.
